## ⭐ The blocker cleared six minutes before I read this card

The card declares `Blocked-by: #16390` and warns ⚠️ 「Both sentences are **TRUE on `origin/main` today** and become false only when PR #17470 merges. ⛔ Do not 'fix' them before then」. That was correct when filed at 16:34Z. Measured now:

| reading | value |
|---|---|
| PR #17470 | **merged 2026-09-10T17:15:02Z** |
| #16390 | **closed** |
| `(#17470)` in `git log --oneline -30 origin/main` | **1** (control: 30 numbered commits in the window) |
| `LOOKUP_TYPES` in `packages/services/service-analytics/` | **0** — the private subset is gone |
| `referenceTargetOf` in that package — **lit control** | present in `src/dimension-labels.ts` and its test |
| `content/docs/data-modeling/analytics.mdx:211` | still 「a `lookup` / `master_detail` dimension returns the related …」 |

⇒ **The sentences are false as of 17:15:02Z.** The card is unblocked and the fence it set has expired — correcting them now is right, not premature. `pm:blocked` is not applied and the `Blocked-by:` line in the body is spent.

⭐ The filing seat's blocking discipline was exactly right and worth naming: it blocked on the **issue** (#16390, which closes via `Fixes`), ⛔ not the PR, precisely so the wait would end at a readable moment. It did.

## Scope

`packages/spec` declares one reference class — `REFERENCE_VALUE_TYPES` = `lookup`, `master_detail`, `user`, `tree`. Both pages enumerate two of the four. ⇒ Add the missing two; ⛔ do not restate the class by listing members if a name for it exists.

⚠️ **The second site is unreachable by the drift tool by construction** — that is the card's own finding and the reason it is a card rather than a tool run. ⇒ Its absence from any drift output is structural, ⛔ not evidence it is fine.

`priority:p3`: authored guidance that under-lists a class by two members. A reader who follows it does less than they could; nothing breaks, and no gate reddens.

## The blocker is spent, re-verified by this seat rather than inherited

The card carries a bolded `Blocked-by: #16390` and an ⚠️ fence: 「Both sentences are **TRUE on `origin/main` today** and become false only when PR #17470 merges. ⛔ Do not "fix" them before then」. Triage (`5622687438`) already recorded that the blocker cleared six minutes after filing, and ⛔ deliberately did **not** apply `pm:blocked`. Re-read here:

| reading (taken 2026-09-16T14:13Z) | value |
| --- | --- |
| **#16390** | `closed / completed` |
| **PR #17470** | **merged**, `113050e2c2` |
| *reading taken* | 2026-09-16T14:13Z, tree `8fe5cb8e5` |

⇒ The fence has **expired in the direction that makes the work correct**: the two sentences are now **false** on `main`, which is exactly when they must be fixed. ⭐ The filing seat blocked on the **issue** rather than the PR precisely so the wait would end at a readable moment — and it did.

## Both sites re-derived on `origin/main` `8fe5cb8e5`, read 2026-09-16T14:13Z

| site | line | still short? |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `content/docs/data-modeling/analytics.mdx` | **:211** — 「a `lookup` / `master_detail` dimension returns the related …」 | yes |
| `content/docs/ui/dashboards.mdx` | **:146** — 「A `sortBy` naming a **select** or **lookup** dimension orders by the …」 | yes |
| `` `user` `` anywhere in either page | **0 / 0** | — |
| `` `tree` `` anywhere in either page | **0 / 0** | — |
| *reading taken* | 2026-09-16T14:13Z, tree `8fe5cb8e5` | |

⚠️ **The spec-side truth, and the honest limit of how this seat read it**: `packages/spec/src/data/field-value.zod.ts:153-155` declares

```
export const REFERENCE_VALUE_TYPES: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set([
  'lookup', 'master_detail', 'user', 'tree',
] as const satisfies readonly FieldType[]);
```

⛔ That is a **source read of the declaration**, not a module import — bare `node` will not load the `.ts` here. It is the `export const` itself and not a comment quoting it, but a dev with the build should confirm by importing. ⚠️ This seat has already been burned once this shift by grepping a table instead of importing it (#17141), and says so rather than overstating this one.

## Fences carried into the dispatch

- ⭐ **Triage's scope note, which is the sharpest constraint**: 「Add the missing two; ⛔ **do not restate the class by listing members if a name for it exists**」. ⇒ Prefer naming the class the spec already names over growing a four-item enumeration in prose. ⛔ Do not simply append `user` / `tree` to each list without asking whether the sentence should name the class instead.
- ⚠️ **Site 2 is unreachable by the drift tool by construction** — that is the card's own finding and the reason it is a card rather than a tool run. ⇒ ⛔ Its absence from any drift output is **structural**, ⛔ never evidence that it is fine.
- ⭐ Site 1 is wrong **in the direction that matters**: a reader asking 「does a person axis render a name?」 reads that enumeration and concludes **no** — the exact belief #16390 was filed to correct. The repair must leave that question answered.
- ⛔ Docs only. ⛔ No `packages/**` change rides along; if the prose needs a spec fact the spec does not state, **stop and report** rather than editing spec.

## 验收:卡自己写下的两处站点,逐条对照

| 卡的要求 | 结果 |
|:--|:--|

| 站点 2 `dashboards.mdx` 同 | ✅ 改为 **`select` or `reference`**,并补一句 **Reference** 是整个类,所以 `user` 人员轴也按名字排序 |

| ⛔ 纯文档,不夹带 `packages/**` | ✅ 2 文件 `+7 −4`,零源码字节 |
